name: Neo Mastercard

apr.notes: Purchase rate 19.99% to 29.99% and cash advance rate 22.99% to 31.99% (Quebec 19.99% to 24.99% and 22.99% to 25.99%), based on credit assessment.

credit_required.notes: Any credit history or income; applicants may be offered a secured credit limit instead.

base_rate.description: Cashback is earned at participating Neo partners; no flat base rate is stated.

rewards.redemption_notes: Cashback can reduce the credit account balance, be added to a Neo Everyday account, or be redeemed for merchandise at the Neo Store.

notes: The issuer page does not name a network package tier, so network_tier is none. A secured version requires refundable security funds and the Build membership.
